verdict.rationale: Anrok assigns each product a product tax category that determines its taxability in each jurisdiction, so SaaS taxability can vary by state. Sellers create one product per unique tax category and map billing-system products onto those categories. Its AI Atlas answers sales-tax questions with the reasoning shown, which partly addresses visible research. Missing for 10: explicit handling of digital-goods rules, any treatment of bundled offerings, visible per-determination taxability research or citations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy on hard cases.
